algorithm.description: OpenPGP public-key algorithm identifier reported by the HKP index.

creation-time.description: Key creation time reported by the keyserver.

expiration-time.description: Key expiration time reported by the keyserver; absence does not establish validity.

fingerprint.description: Full OpenPGP fingerprint in uppercase hexadecimal, without 0x or spaces.

flags.description: Raw HKP flags, for example r (revoked), d (disabled) or e (expired). These are keyserver claims.

key.description: ASCII-armored public key block. Keyserver retrieval does not establish ownership or validate certifications.

key-id.description: Hexadecimal key ID without 0x. Short IDs can collide; use the full fingerprint to identify a key.

key-length.description: Public-key length in bits reported by the HKP index.

keyserver.description: Base URL of the source HKP keyserver.

retrieval-url.description: URL used to retrieve the public key by full fingerprint.

uid.description: Complete OpenPGP User ID as reported by the keyserver. Names and email addresses are unverified claims; attribute comments can preserve UID flags.

description: An OpenPGP public key and its keyserver index data. Link a pgp-meta object to this object using extracted-from to keep pivotable key IDs, names and emails separate from the key artifact.
name: pgp-key
